Apple is rolling out the RC (Release Candidate) versions of its latest wave of software updates, including iPadOS 26.6, watchOS 26.6, and more. Here's what you can expect.

The RC versions signal that Apple's 26.6 updates are nearly ready for official release.

Major new versions of Apple's systems, such as iOS 27, iPadOS 27, and macOS Golden Gate, are expected to arrive陆续 this fall.

However, rather than these new versions, another wave of updates within the current "OS 26" cycle will be rolling out sooner.

Updates including iOS 26.6, iPadOS 26.6, and macOS 26.6 are即将面世, with the RC versions of these updates released today.

Apple has issued RC versions for all its即将推出的 26.6 updates, including iPadOS 26.6, watchOS 26.6, tvOS 26.6, and more.

RC versions are released after the Beta testing period ends, and are intended to be identical to the software versions that will be正式推送 to the public稍後.

However, it's not uncommon for Apple to release revised RC versions during this period if other bugs are discovered, incorporating last-minute fixes.

In any case, since Apple has the RC versions of the 26.6 updates ready, the new versions are expected to launch officially in about a week.

Based on the current Beta cycle, these updates appear to focus mainly on under-the-hood optimizations rather than new features. If anything changes, we'll provide further updates.

Have you found anything new in Apple's 26.6 updates or the RC versions? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
